title: Guest shadowbanned after posting photo with Malone at Heretic-con

tellings.quote: Honestly, same when I posted that picture uh with him back in Heredicon, dude, I got shadowbanned instantly.

plain: An unnamed researcher on the show says that when he posted a picture of himself with Robert Malone, a doctor known for public controversy, taken at a gathering called Heretic-con, he was "shadowbanned instantly" on X, the site once called Twitter, meaning his posts were quietly hidden from others. He tells it as something that happened to him in the 2020s. To him it shows how fast certain associations get suppressed online.
